company.name: Fintoc
company.shortDescription: Fintoc is an API that lets online businesses accept instant payments coming directly from the customer’s bank account.
company.description: Fintoc is an API that lets online businesses accept instant payments coming directly from the customer’s bank account. The company was founded in March 2020 by Cristóbal Griffero and Lukas Zorich and is headquartered in 	Santiago, Region Metropolitana, Chile.

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven service enabling businesses to accept instant payments directly from customers' bank accounts with lower transaction fees than card payments.
productsAndServices.name: Iniciación de Pagos (Payment Initiation)

productsAndServices.description: A service that automates the reconciliation of payments by matching transactions with bank statements to simplify payment management and collection processes.
productsAndServices.name: Conciliación Bancaria (Bank Reconciliation)

productsAndServices.description: A digital and automated service that simplifies recurring payment collections by transforming traditional automatic account payments into an API-driven process.
productsAndServices.name: Débito Directo (Direct Debit)

productsAndServices.description: A service that facilitates sending payments to multiple bank accounts, such as suppliers, employees, or customers, through an automated and scalable API-driven system.
productsAndServices.name: Payouts (Money Dispersal Service)

productsAndServices.description: Business accounts designed to receive high volumes of payments and automate reconciliation and financial-flow management.
productsAndServices.name: Programmable Business Accounts

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $7,000,000, or 65.64% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,587,899 to $41,789,922, a 26.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
